cases.why: the share-link guard goes. A bare '#picks=...' still fails the page check by luck, but a share payload after a route-shaped head ('#board/...&picks=...', which readSharedPicksFromUrl also accepts) reads as the Week Board and switches pages under the shared view.
any hash that is not a route opens the Week Board, so clicking a Methodology jump link (#part-method) throws the reader off the page they are reading.
an unknown team is passed through, so #team/ZZZ sets the team select to a value it has no option for and the page shows an empty or stale team.
the address written for a board week leaves the week out, so a copied link to week 2 opens on the latest week.
a page change replaces the history entry instead of adding one, so Back leaves the site instead of returning to the previous page.
cases.find: if(location.pathname + location.search + location.hash !== url) history.pushState(null, '', url);
cases.replace: if(location.pathname + location.search + location.hash !== url) history.replaceState(null, '', url);
